name: Aeon Kyushu Co., Ltd.
summary: Aeon Kyushu Co., Ltd. is a Japanese retailer that runs grocery supermarkets, lifestyle stores, department stores, home improvement centers with DIY, pet and gardening goods, and bicycle shops, and also sells through e-commerce. Dating from 1972 with headquarters in Fukuoka City, Japan, it is a subsidiary of Aeon Co., Ltd.
